definition: The finite coordinate set S recorded by a normal support witness after canonical relabeling.
runtime_analogue: support_size field plus canonical schema row
mathematical_role: Domain from which active and inactive coordinates are selected.
relation_to_previous_operation: Delete operation removes one c in S.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection restricts from S to active_support(W).

definition: The union of coordinates used by obstruction payload, counterexample certificate, frontier/shell/tail descriptors, canonical motif dependencies, and recognized family-chain lift fields.
runtime_analogue: support_gt8_witness_anatomy active_support row plus payload/lift descriptors
mathematical_role: Defines the coordinates that must survive projection.
relation_to_previous_operation: Redundant coordinate deletion checks one coordinate outside this union.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection target is this union as a whole.
caveat: Completeness for arbitrary mathematical witnesses remains proof-sketch.

runtime_analogue: no standalone runtime column; derived from support_set and active descriptors
mathematical_role: Candidate support removed by active projection.
relation_to_previous_operation: A redundant coordinate can be one inactive coordinate.
relation_to_current_operation: All inactive coordinates are removed together.
caveat: Only yields smaller witness if nonempty.

definition: Coordinate-level predicate: a presented coordinate is unused by payload/certificate/family-chain fields.
relation_to_previous_operation: This was the previous selected operation.
relation_to_current_operation: Not identical to inactive_support; inactive_support is set-level.
caveat: Do not use as proof that every inactive projection is valid.

definition: A coordinate whose removal changes the active payload, certificate, motif, or lift fields.
mathematical_role: Blocks active projection from removing it.
relation_to_previous_operation: Deletion operation must prove chosen c is not essential.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection keeps every essential coordinate by definition.
caveat: Essentiality outside runtime rows needs formal witness language.

relation_to_previous_operation: May be deleted one-by-one if redundancy predicate is presented.
relation_to_current_operation: Removed by project_to_active_support when inactive_support nonempty.

definition: The restriction W|active_support(W), followed by selected support normal-form renormalization.
relation_to_previous_operation: Generalizes deletion from one redundant coordinate to the whole inactive complement.

definition: A normal witness whose support set equals its active support.
runtime_analogue: support normal form plus active_support equality
mathematical_role: No smaller witness from active projection.
relation_to_previous_operation: After deleting all redundant/inactive coordinates, deletion no longer applies.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection is no-op and routes to next operation.
caveat: Does not prove irreducibility under contraction/compression.

definition: Recognized family-chain source form must have all recognizer and lift fields contained in active support.
relation_to_previous_operation: Delete operation required deleted coordinate outside family fields.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection keeps all family-chain fields by active-support definition.

definition: Canonical motif coordinates used to compare witnesses are included in active support.
runtime_analogue: canonical rowset equality and motif fingerprints
mathematical_role: Separates active projection from motif compression.
relation_to_previous_operation: Delete operation only reindexed after deleting c.

definition: Payload/refinement coordinates are included in active support so projection can preserve the payload relation.
relation_to_previous_operation: Delete operation preserved payload if c absent.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection preserves payload if active support contains all payload coordinates.
caveat: Full payload-refinement preservation is not proved.

definition: If active_support(W)=S or projection fails to preserve required fields, this operation yields no smaller witness and routes to next operation or named escape.
relation_to_current_operation: Projection failure is non-application or named blocker, not proof success.
caveat: Higher-support closure still needs a bound theorem.

definition: Active support language is first-class for the project-to-active operation.
mathematical_role: Provides input language for projection proof skeleton.
relation_to_previous_operation: Extends previous deletion language without merging operations.
relation_to_current_operation: Ready for operation semantics and obligations.
caveat: No arbitrary support-growth theorem is claimed.
